input.reflection:
Third consecutive disciplined no-trade day. The setup is essentially identical to 5/4 and 5/5: position cap already breached at 7, top Super candidates extended past pivot, book full of winners doing their job. The right action remains inaction.

What changed today vs yesterday: TER (yesterday's most actionable Super at 14.6% off high, near-pivot) gapped +7.1% overnight to $382.48 — a 10.5%+ chase above its $323.36 pivot. This is a perfect real-time validation of the 'no FOMO if missed pivot by >3%' rule: had I bought TER yesterday near 357 (still 10% above pivot), I'd be sitting on a nice gap up; but the systematic answer 'wait for proper pivot or skip' was correct ex-ante and remains correct ex-post — the alternative scenario where TER gapped DOWN 7% on bad news would have left me eating an 8% stop on a chased entry. Process > outcome.

Meanwhile STX prints a third straight day at 0.0% from 52w high, increasingly confirming rule [744aa229]. The screener keeps surfacing late-stage strength because we're deep into a strong leg — that's a feature of the regime, not a screener bug.

Book performance is the entire story: MU +25.7%, VRT +15.6%, FIX +13.6%, AMAT +10.9%, JBL +9.9%, ADI +5.6%, GEV +1.8%. Total unrealized P&L on the 7 names is approximately +$4,336. Earnings sweep clean for all 7 across the next 7 days. No trim/exit triggers (none broke MA50, none down >7% from entry, none have earnings within sweep window).

Shadow log over-trading bias (32 decisions, 19 would-buys, 1 skip across 5 days) remains my biggest behavioral risk. Three live no-trade days in a row is the correct counterweight, but I should not get complacent — the next genuinely fresh Super setup at a proper pivot with clean fundamentals and earnings runway will be tradeable, even with 7 open, IF a current position has been trimmed/exited first. I will not force that today; no name in the book has a thesis break.

No new rule warranted. Today's situation is fully covered by: 5-position cap, far-from-pivot avoidance [744aa229], no-FOMO 3% chase rule, daily book earnings sweep [4/29 rule]. Execution > new theory, three days running.
